summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper and supporting changes; nothing committed. (1) botocore/regions.py: added `import enum` and appended the str-mixin EndpointResolverBuiltins enum with the eleven members, each commented with meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported it as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept an absent endpoint config (no variant tags); added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean, returning a dict keyed by enum members. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derived from unittest.TestCase) with one test per behavioral criterion, one custom-data legacy test and one bundled-data test (the defaults test). Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 58 passed; test_args.py, test_client.py, test_regions.py 414 passed. Choices: SDK::Endpoint absent is returned as None with the key present; FIPS and DualStack use the bridge's private _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint as the spec directs. Line-length check: only botocore/args.py:315 exceeds 79 columns, and it is pre-existing code, not part of this change.
